text: A tiny floating island at night with a garden bed of red crops and a bunny-eared creature. It says 'Tap the ripe crop' with a yellow box around the bed. Day 2, 20/30 sec. I'll tap the crops.
Day turned to bright morning, the bunny turned white in daylight. Seeds are in. Now it says tap again to water. Days are only 30 seconds long!
The Momo moved and harvested by itself I think (coins went 14->18). My tap missed because it walked. Trying again on its new spot.
Caught the Momo on the third try (it kept walking off). A panel: Momo, 'Free time', Assign. Hint says tap the pencil to pick tiles this Momo looks after. The hint bubble covers the panel text a bit.

Assigned the farm to Momo (1/4 tiles). A wall of text popped up: empty tiles can build farm, mine, lumberyard or lab; demolish with bin + check. Lots to read at once. There's a yellow box on the empty tile to the left - I guess that's where to build next.
Momo is farming on its own now, $4 per harvest, $16/min. Hint: I can buy the sea beside the island for $25. I have $30. Let's expand!

Bought land! A new tile rose out of the sea with a tree and flower bush. Satisfying. $21 left, almost level 2. The Momo has an envelope bubble over it and Mailbox has a red dot - I'll tap the envelope.
Oops, tapping the envelope bubble selected the sea tile behind it ($35, not enough money). The bubble is not tappable? Hit Level 2 though. I'll open the Mailbox button instead.
Momo wrote me a letter! Cute - it proposes 'Field expansion' research: closer rows. There is a 'Let's research it' button. Charming way to introduce upgrades. Tapping it.

Research tree is big: Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... Field expansion needs 3 flasks + $20, and the button says 'Build a research lab'. So I need a lab first. Closing and tapping an empty grass tile to build one. $73 now.
Build menu: Farm $10, Mine (opens Lv3), Lumberyard $80, Research lab $40, Special 0/1. Building the lab here.
Lab is built - cute blue-roof house with a flask. My Momo walked over to it and seems to be experimenting. But then the farm has ripe tomatoes no one picks? Only one Momo. Tapping Experiment.
Flasks 2/3 already - the lab makes flasks. Momo seems to juggle both farm and lab. One more flask then I can research Field expansion. Checking new mail meanwhile.
3/3 flasks! Start research is lit up. Starting Field expansion.
Confetti - Level 3, Mine unlocked! Research running 29s. Wondering how to get more Momos; one bunny doing everything feels slow. Let me peek at the Shop.
Shop has 'Hire Momo $50'. Yes! I have $85. Hiring.
Hired a second bunny named Mochi! It waves at me. Going to assign Mochi to the lab so Momo can farm.
Lab tile marked '1' for Mochi. Panel says 'Comparing: a few days are needed on each side' - no idea what that means. Confirming with the check.
Mochi still says 'Free time' even though I picked the lab tile. Maybe the Assign button is the real step? Trying it.
Assign didn't seem to do anything visible; Mochi still 'Free time'. Confusing. Income is up to $60/min though. Research has a red dot, checking it.

Field expansion done (Lv1/5). Watering efficiency unlocked: $40, 5 flasks, 1m30s, wait after water -25%. $111 so I'll start it. Mochi's panel now shows 'Since the change: 0 -> 0 jobs a day', so it tracks before/after stats.
Now one bunny is at the farm and one at the lab, $80/min. Seems it worked after all. Next: build a cheap second farm on the empty left tile ($10).
Mine now needs $120 + 10 wood, so I need a lumberyard first. Curious what 'Special 0/1' is - tapping it.
Special = landmarks: Clock Tower (Lv5), School (Lv4), Momo Monument (Lv6). Something to look forward to. Going back to build a Lumberyard ($80, I have $143) so I can work toward the Mine.
Lumberyard going up on the left tile. It says 0/1 - needs a worker. Both bunnies are busy, so I'll hire a third from the Shop.
Lumberyard done; a bunny wandered over to it on its own. Hire price went up to $80. Sunset sky is gorgeous. Hiring a third Momo.
Third bunny Pomu hired (it said -$72, not $80 - odd). Now assigning Pomu to the lumberyard with the pencil.

Watering efficiency finished. Pomu still says 'Free time' even after assigning the lumberyard tile - same confusion as with Mochi. There's a dashed line from Pomu to the lumberyard, so maybe it's on its way. Let me look at Status.

Status shows a clear goal: grow Village into City - Land 5/9, Momo 3/3 done, Research levels 2/3, Value $438/$1.5K. Nice, a real target! Also Pomu now says 'Working at Lumberyard' - it just updates late. Next: one more research level, then buy land.
Starting Bigger harvests ($60, 2 min) - that should be my 3rd research level for the City goal. Then I'll spend leftovers on land.
Bought another tile ($35, +19 EXP). Island is growing into an L-shape. $156 left, $152/min. Going for more land toward the 9 needed.

New tile at the back with a tree, bush and rocks - rocks maybe for the mine later? Land is 7 now I think. Price shown $45 but the float said -$37; probably income mixed in. Trying for one more tile to the right.
Land 8/9 now, research 2/3 with Bigger harvests still cooking, value $720/$1.5K. One more tile and I'm close to City. Buying one more.
Bought a 9th tile ($75) - the price label was half hidden behind the lab and a bunny, but tapping again worked. The island looks lush now. Almost level 4 (541/550). Checking Status one last time.
Level 4! Land 9/9 and Momo 3/3 checked. Just need research 3/3 (Bigger harvests finishing) and $1.5K value. School landmark should be open at Lv4 now. I'd keep going to become a City.
